intro: Lesson 82: Add and subtract decimals with different numbers of places. To understand how to add and subtract decimals with different numbers of decimal places

questions.q: A 2.5 m plank has 0.75 m and 1.2 m cut off. How much is left?
Write a subtraction of two decimals with different places whose answer is 1.09.
Big question: why line up the points?
questions.a: So each digit is added to or taken from the same place value.
